mission_result: The parent route is directionally correct but still risks stopping one layer too early at design/specification. The immediate multiplicative bottleneck is no longer merely 'we need a Planner concept'; it is the missing executable metabolic spine that converts durable generation evidence and Steward dispositions into an emitted next-generation READY queue, then proves the same transformation again on the generated workers' returns without human task design. Keep the current acceleration wave running, but make the next gate an executable two-generation vertical slice rather than another broad design/convergence cycle.

checkpoint_completion.finding: Wave1 proved useful parallel execution but not compounding: 7 durable/integrated returns, 0 automatically generated opportunities, next_generation_generated_without_human=false, and context receipt coverage=0.
Compared the current broad acceleration wave against a metabolic-spine-first vertical slice and against premature scale/background automation.
Preserve active parallel work, but stop allowing new broad design artifacts to become the default frontier before an actual generated N+1 and N+2 are durable.
Four concrete candidate next-work items are specified below with deterministic pass/fail conditions.

Self-assignment/claim uniqueness/return-DONE/post-return have canary evidence, while Context Fabric actual use is DESIGNED_NOT_USED, automatic stale/retry is UNPROVEN, and recursive Planner N+1 is UNPROVEN.

Parent correctly selected a parallel acceleration route and explicitly requires N+1 without human batch design, but the trigger currently depends on a Planner candidate becoming available and subsequent parent/Planner consumption rather than already naming an executable compiler artifact and closed-loop proof as the gate.

The concurrent Planner worker is STARTED and has independently confirmed automatic work regeneration as the bottleneck; its CP3 deterministic N->N+1 algorithm is in progress and its two-generation canary checkpoint remains pending at this critic checkpoint. No durable Planner RETURN existed when checked.

Candidate architecture already defines Steward/Merger separation, immutable RETURN evidence, append-only integration/consumption, Context Fabric direction and verification law. More broad architecture prose is not the main missing capability.

The method itself names the frontier as returns/proposals/incidents/critic findings -> Planner -> READY Queue -> workers -> returns -> Steward -> next Planner generation and requires executable proof before production /w.
Continuous Planner/second-generation work is explicitly NOT YET OPERATIONAL and described as a major reason the growth curve remains sublinear.
Compiled packet reports current chat-native workstream on main head 09db1870bd9716c8d9e18b3700ae474556e377ed and retains parent/steward integration authority.
Relevant overlaps shown for chat-native-control-plane-v1 are non-blocking/informational at the compiled epoch; no hard collision applies to this worker's isolated claim/run/return paths.

bottleneck.name: EXECUTABLE_CLOSED_LOOP_REGENERATION
bottleneck.statement: The system can distribute prepared work, but it does not yet have a proven executable transition from raw durable evidence plus explicit integration dispositions to a generated next-generation queue and then through the same transition a second time.
bottleneck.why_more_precise_than_current_label: 'Planner regeneration' is directionally right, but a Planner design can still leave the parent as semantic compiler/merger. The gate must include the ingestion boundary, deterministic queue emission, provenance, and repeated end-to-end execution; otherwise a sophisticated design artifact can be mistaken for metabolism.
bottleneck.hidden_parent_dependency: Wave1 integration was parent/steward driven. If generation N+1 consumes parent-written summaries rather than raw RETURN/proposal/incident/critic refs plus explicit scope-aware dispositions, the human may be out of the loop but the parent chat remains a non-reproducible semantic bottleneck.

route_comparison.description: Continue the current eight-way verification/Planner/metrics/Context/critic/event-loop acceleration wave, then reconcile outputs.
strengths: already in flight, so cancelling would waste useful work
risks: several opportunities are DESIGN/BUILD_DESIGN/RUNTIME_DESIGN and may create another layer of candidate artifacts

integration burden can delay the one proof that matters most: automatically emitted next work

route_comparison.description: As soon as sufficient Planner/critic/metrics evidence lands, implement the smallest deterministic evidence->disposition->Planner->Queue compiler, emit GEN N+1, run generated workers, then emit GEN N+2 with no human task design.
strengths: forces the Planner/Steward handoff to become executable instead of conversational
uses current queue/claim/run/return machinery rather than rebuilding it
reversible and authority-safe because emitted work remains candidate/prepared queue state
can use explicit read_scope/context receipts initially without waiting for full Context Fabric
risks: requires deterministic handling of unresolved/conflicted evidence rather than free-form synthesis
may expose missing integration disposition schemas that need a small bridge artifact

route_comparison.description: Promote production /w, open more workers, or deploy the external event loop before proving the closed-loop generation transition.
strengths: increases apparent concurrency or unattended triggering
risks: scales coordination/integration debt rather than regeneration
could produce background activity without semantic compounding

plan_deltas.change: Replace 'Planner candidate available' as the next strategic gate with 'executable compiler emits a deterministic N+1 queue from durable generation evidence and integration dispositions'.
plan_deltas.preserves: Current active acceleration work, architecture candidates, authority separation and /wc canary status.

plan_deltas.change: Require the same compiler path to consume the generated workers' durable results and emit N+2 before calling recursive Planner operational.
plan_deltas.preserves: The two-generation requirement already present in the Planner opportunity and verification law, but turns it into the explicit promotion gate.

plan_deltas.change: Do not make full Context Fabric or unattended scheduling prerequisites for the first metabolic-spine canary. Use explicit role/task read_scope + receipts for the first closed-loop proof; improve retrieval and wake-up independently afterward.
plan_deltas.reason: Context quality and unattended triggering are scaling multipliers, but neither should block proof that the semantic loop itself closes.

plan_deltas.change: Integrate acceleration returns incrementally as they land. Do not wait for all eight before executing the metabolic-spine build if Planner plus enough evidence is available.
plan_deltas.reason: A full-wave barrier creates avoidable serialization and contradicts the non-regression/throughput posture.

plan_deltas.change: Planner inputs should be durable raw refs plus typed dispositions/provenance, not a parent-authored narrative summary that cannot be replayed deterministically.
plan_deltas.reason: Otherwise the parent remains the hidden Context/Steward/Planner compiler even when the human is no longer routing tasks.

stop_doing: Do not make another broad architecture essay the default frontier before an actual generated N+1 exists.
Do not count more active chats or more candidate specs as evidence of compounding.
Do not wait for the entire acceleration wave if an executable next gate can start from already-returned evidence.
Do not require full Context Fabric implementation before the first N->N+1->N+2 canary; require receipts and explicit context instead.
Do not accept parent-written free-form synthesis as the only bridge from worker evidence to Planner inputs.
Do not call a Planner contract operational until generated queue bytes, worker claims/returns, and a second generated queue are durable.
Do not promote production /w or spend the frontier on Live presentation while recursive generation and stale/retry remain unproven.

critic_challenge_to_parent_self_verifica.agreement: The parent correctly refused production /w, correctly identified automatic work regeneration as the main throughput gap, and correctly launched a parallel acceleration generation rather than returning to broad architecture-only work.
critic_challenge_to_parent_self_verifica.challenge: The parent still risks equating a returned Planner design with the operational transition it describes. Its own next-generation trigger should be hardened so a design return causes BUILD+CANARY execution, not merely another parent synthesis/replanning pass.
critic_challenge_to_parent_self_verifica.falsifiable_question: After the current Planner return lands, can a fresh successor point only at durable inputs and run one deterministic path that emits N+1, then repeat it after generated worker returns to emit N+2, with no human-authored task semantics? If not, Prometeo is still parallel rather than self-compounding.
